$description: Desktop app roles (ADR 0016/0017). Two surfaces with identical keys: 'journal' is the light working area of the main window, the snippet picker and the side panel (text content); 'stage' is the navy control surface of the recording dock, the recording overlay and the floating button. Aliases point at primitives only. Consumed by tool/design_tokens/generate_dart.dart; the website does not read this file.

pane.$description: List column next to the detail.

surface-sunken.$description: Wells inside a surface (example boxes, code).

selected.$description: Selected nav item, active segment, selected row (cyan.500 14%).

border-control.$description: Inputs and checkboxes, 3:1 against the surface.

switch-track-off.$description: Off-state switch track. White thumb on it >= 3:1, track on the window ground >= 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11).

selection-border.$description: Unselected colour swatch boundary (ticket). One solid value for both themes: 3:1 or better on every journal surface (3.7:1 at the weakest, canvas E6EEF7) and every stage surface (3.6:1 at the weakest, card 122247). Dark alpha borders reach only 2.1:1, so they are not used.

accent.$description: Petrol: secondary actions, links, icons, active nav text, tab indicator. AA on every journal surface.

accent-fill.$description: Filled emphasis on light (checkbox, switch track, rare primary button).

action.$description: Bright cyan: recording / dictation action. On light only as a fill with navy text, never as text.

primary-record.$description: Primary record button fill (dock dictate). Cyan in light and dark. The navy set uses amber for this role (ticket); that value lives in theme_colors.dart, because the generator emits only journal and stage.

recording.$description: Recording indicators drawn on light (waveform, dot).

highlight.$description: Amber marker block, favourite star. Targeted accent surfaces allowed, with AA ink.

success-icon.$description: Status dot/check on light; paired with text, never alone.

border-control.$description: Selector outline on the navy stage, 3:1 against the canvas (WCAG 1.4.11). Was 25 % alpha (2.1:1).

text-disabled.$description: Disabled text on the navy stage: the only exemption from 4.5:1, still 3:1 or more.

switch-track-off.$description: Off-state switch track on the navy stage: white thumb 4.3:1, track on the navy ground 4.3:1. Lighter tracks (frost.400) fail the thumb check.

selection-border.$description: Unselected colour swatch boundary (ticket). One solid value for both themes: 3:1 or better on every journal surface (3.7:1 at the weakest, canvas E6EEF7) and every stage surface (3.6:1 at the weakest, card 122247). Dark alpha borders reach only 2.1:1, so they are not used.

sidebar-width-compact.$description: Icon-only rail below the compact breakpoint.

dock-height.$description: Recording dock height (ticket, ADR 0024): 48 px controls with 14 px above and below.

reading-measure.$description: Max line length of body text in editors and detail views.

breakpoint-compact.$description: Below: sidebar collapses to rail, list/detail stack.

field-height.$description: Search field height (spec §3); sits under the 48 px touch target.

focus-ring-width.$description: Focus ring stroke in the app (WpFocusRing): a crisp solid outline, same 2px as the website ring. No blur (UIA-VIS-12, no-glow rule).

focus-ring-gap.$description: Gap between a focused control and its focus ring in the app.

dock.$description: Recording dock component geometry (ticket, ADR 0024). Breakpoints are dock widths: the dock width is the window minus the sidebar minus 2 x dock-inset.

control-height.$description: Every dock control (Dictate, selectors, keycap, overflow): the 48 px desktop hit target.

control-radius.$description: Selector and keycap corner radius. The same on every control (8 px, UIA-FND-02).

dictate-width-compact.$description: Dictate button once the keycap and the labels give way.

item-gap.$description: Gap between dock items (controls, keycap, status).

breakpoint-labels.$description: Dock width from which selectors show their overline label (window of about 1256 px with the full sidebar).

breakpoint-compact.$description: Dock width below which the selectors other than the engine move into Mehr.

lead.$description: Hanken 700, line height 1.3. A sentence that opens a page under its title (Overview greeting).

figure.$description: Hanken 700, line height 1.15, tabular figures. The value of a key figure.

onboarding.$description: First-run onboarding stage (Onboarding v6, V12). A very low-contrast vertical ground on the navy stage only; cards and controls stay flat. Top is one step lighter than the canvas, bottom is the canvas.

coffee.$description: Coffee support button (Kaffee-Gelb): fill, hover fill and ink. Consumed by tool/design_tokens/generate_dart.dart as WpCoffeeTokens.

overlay.$description: Recording overlay pill and floating record button (ADR 0024). Background presets: one flat fill (surface), glyph ink and glyph outline. Wave presets: one value per tone (dark or light, set per background in Dart), plus a darker light step (light-strong) tried before the ink when the light value falls below 3:1 on the fill. Signal presets: state colours per tone. Consumed by tool/design_tokens/generate_dart.dart as WpOverlayTokens.

surface.$description: Marine (dark): the flat fill. The default overlay background is amber.

edge.$description: Marine: 1 px light outer edge (UX-048), white at 18 percent, so the dark pill reads on a dark desktop.
Graphit: 1 px light outer edge (UX-048), white at 18 percent.

ink.$description: Gletscher: glyph fill (dark ink on light).

edge.$description: Gletscher: no edge. A light pill already reads on any desktop that a dark preset would not, so no outline is drawn.

surface.$description: Amber (Bernstein, light): one flat fill. The wave and signals are checked against it; dark ink takes over where a colour cannot reach 3:1.

ink.$description: Amber: glyph fill (dark ink on amber, about 10.5:1).

edge.$description: Amber: no edge (light preset, see gletscher).

dark.$description: Painted pill and button shadow on a dark preset: black at 36 percent (was 20 percent), so the drop shadow adds depth on a dark desktop (UX-048).

light.$description: Painted pill and button shadow on a light preset: black at 20 percent (unchanged).

light-strong.$description: Darker cyan step on a light background, used when the base cyan falls below 3:1 (e.g. on amber).
Darker violett step on a light background (fallback step).

light.$description: Amber on a light background (3.9:1 on the amber fill).

light-strong.$description: Darkest amber step; equal to the base step, kept so every wave has a pair.

dark.$description: Ink (black) on a dark background. Invalid there: the contrast stays far below 3:1, so the pairing is disabled.

light.$description: Ink (black) on a light background. The former Neutral preset (retired 2026-10-29) loads as ink.

light-strong.$description: Equal to the base step; kept so every wave has a pair.

light.$description: Coral on a light background (5.6:1 on glacier, 3.7:1 on amber).

light-strong.$description: Equal to the base step; kept so every wave has a pair.

light.$description: Mint on a light background (5.6:1 on glacier, 3.8:1 on amber).

light-strong.$description: Equal to the base step; kept so every wave has a pair.

dot.$description: Recording dot on a dark background.

transcribing.$description: Processing spinner and ripple on dark.

dot.$description: Recording dot on a light background.

transcribing.$description: Processing spinner and ripple on light.
